jobs.description:
Are you looking to strengthen your experience in banking operations within an international environment? We are seeking a detail-oriented Operations Associate to support payments, cash management, trade finance, and client service activities while ensuring operational excellence.

Client Details

Our client is a leading international financial institution supporting corporate clients across global markets.

Description

Process and monitor domestic and international payment transactions.

Manage client and internal stakeholder queries via email and telephone.

Support cash management and banking operations activities.

Handle trade finance documentation and transaction follow-up.

Maintain banking records, account administration, and compliance-related updates.

Contribute to operational controls, reconciliations, and process improvement initiatives.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Banking, Economics, or Business.

Previous experience of 2 to 5 years in banking operations, payments, back office, or financial services.

Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.

Fluent in English, Dutch and French are a plus.

Comfortable working with deadlines and multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

We’re looking for an extra colleague with a passion for refrigeration engineering to join a small, family-run business in Ardooie. The team consists of five people and works on refrigeration systems, air conditioning and heat pumps on a daily basis.

What will you be doing?

• You’ll be visiting customers and working on various installations. So there’s plenty of variety!
• Installing and commissioning air conditioning systems and heat pumps.
• Working on various refrigeration systems.
• Carrying out maintenance and troubleshooting faults.
• Resolving technical issues for customers.
• Ensuring a neat finish and satisfied customers.
 

Who are we looking for?

• You’re interested in refrigeration technology, air conditioning and heat pumps.
• You have a technical background or are keen to learn the trade.
• A basic knowledge of electricity would be an advantage.
• You hold a Category B driving licence.
• You enjoy working independently, but are also a real team player.
• You are motivated and keen to learn new skills.
• You speak Dutch, English or French fluently.

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing organisation operating within a highly technical and project-driven production environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess the manufacturability and technical feasibility of customer-approved designs, identifying risks, constraints, and optimisation opportunities.
• Create and maintain production documentation including technical drawings, CAD models, work instructions, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ERP master data.
• Provide technical support to production teams, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and contribute to root cause analyses and corrective actions.
• Optimise designs, materials, and production processes to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance manufacturing performance.
• Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Engineering teams to ensure technical alignment and operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Engineering, Design Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, technical design, or a similar production-focused role.
• Strong proficiency with CAD software (such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor) and experience managing BOMs, routings, and technical master data in ERP systems (SAP, Dynamics, or similar).
• Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability principles, technical problem solving, and cost estimation within an industrial environment.
• Analytical, detail-oriented, and hands-on professional with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Fluent in English and Dutch

jobs.occupation: IT Project Manager – Application Integration & Data Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Analyze user requirements and collaborate with external partners to design effective technical solutions.
• Coordinate cross-application implementations and integrations while maintaining the integrity of the overarching data model.
• Lead multiple IT projects, serving as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and third-party IT vendors.
• Oversee validation activities and participate in active testing to ensure high-quality software delivery.
• Monitor application availability and security while implementing continuous improvements to the IT landscape.
• Manage implementation risks and challenge business requests to ensure alignment with technical governance.

Requirements

• You have experience in professional roles such as IT Functional Analyst, Project Manager, or Data Expert.
• You possess a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent expertise.
• You bring experience with IT Governance processes, specifically focusing on Release Management and Change Management.
• You possess strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset with the ability to investigate data-level issues independently.
• You're a clear and proactive communicator, capable of managing relationships with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
• You are native in Dutch with a strong knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes or the Telecom industry.
• Technical familiarity with SQL, Scripting, or ETL processing.
• Experience working with GIS data.
• Curiosity regarding emerging IT evolutions and a drive for continuous optimization.

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Jobomschrijving

• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language

- You are comfortable working with computers and internal systems.

jobs.occupation: Technical Service Manager - Industrial Technology Leader
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international industrial technology group specializing in environmental solutions for highly regulated industries. To support the growth of its aftermarket activities, the company is looking for a Service Manager to lead service operations in Belgium, develop long-term customer relationships and drive recurring service revenue through maintenance, inspections and technical support.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and coordinate daily service activities across Belgium
• Plan and optimize technician schedules and field interventions
• Manage external contractors and service partners
• Conduct technical inspections and customer visits
• Identify improvement opportunities and prepare service proposals
• Develop and expand maintenance and service contracts within existing accounts
• Ensure high service quality, safety and customer satisfaction
• Support the future growth of the service department and service offering

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering or similar technical field
• Minimum 10 years of experience in maintenance, inspections, field service or technical service environments
• Strong electrical and automation understanding
• Comfortable working with digital technologies, sensors and connected equipment
• Experience coordinating technicians, subcontractors or service activities
• Fluent Dutch and French are essential
• Good professional English skills
• Hands-on leader with strong customer focus
• Team player able to work in a structured international environment

Are you passionate about category development, negotiation and commercial performance? As a Category Manager - Wholesale, you will shape the product assortment, identify new market opportunities and build strong supplier relationships. Based in Antwerp, you will play a key role in driving sales, profitability and sustainable growth within the wholesale sector.

 

 

Your responsibilities :

• Develop and optimise the product assortment throughout its lifecycle.
• Drive sales, margins and product turnover through effective category strategies and performance monitoring.
• Identify market trends and translate data into actionable growth opportunities.
• Negotiate competitive agreements, pricing and promotions while building long-term supplier partnerships.
• Collaborate with sales and marketing and coordinate purchase support and replenishment activities.
• Improve purchasing processes and operational efficiency.
 

About you :

• You have a bachelor's or master's degree and experience in purchasing, category management or commercial negotiations.
• You are analytical, commercially minded and confident in negotiations.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and French and have a good command of English.
• You are proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership and working with different stakeholders.
• Experience in FMCG, food, beverages or convenience, along with knowledge of Excel and ERP systems, is an advantage.

Responsibilities

• Manage, maintain, and automate Azure infrastructures following Infrastructure as Code principles.
• Support container platforms based on Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
• Implement and monitor logging, alerting, and performance solutions for cloud environments.
• Maintain cloud network components, security configurations, and access management.
• Provide technical coaching and knowledge transfer to ensure long-term expertise within the team.
• Analyze existing infrastructure to resolve configuration drift and optimize operational continuity.
• Collaborate with stakeholders in an Agile environment to align security and compliance requirements.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience with cloud platforms focusing on Microsoft Azure, AKS, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
• 8+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, including state management and modularization.
• 5+ years of experience with containerization technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
• 5+ years of experience with CI/CD automation and version control using GitHub Actions and Git.
• 5+ years of experience with scripting for automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
• 3+ years of experience with cloud networking components including Azure Firewall, vWAN, VNets, and DNS.
• 3+ years of experience with monitoring and security tools such as Azure Monitor, Grafana, Key Vault, and RBAC.
• Possess a proactive, result-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Demonstrate a collaborative approach within multidisciplined Agile teams.
• You are native in Dutch or French with professional working knowledge of the other and good professional English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications such as AZ-400, AZ-104, CKA, or CKAD.
• Experience with GitOps principles and tooling like Flux.
• Experience working in regulated environments or the public sector.
• Familiarity with Jira for project management.
• Willingness to coach and train technical colleagues.
